title: The Priced Line a Coverage Credit Is Measured Against
content:
# Service Training Note: The Priced Line a Coverage Credit Is Measured Against

## The rule the desk applies

When a protection coverage answers for bench work at the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, the credit is measured against one priced line of the work order, and which line that is turns on the checks standing on the order and on how the coverage stands in the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans records.

1. Where a check stands on the work order that found rework needed and the coverage stands in force, the credit is measured against the largest bench labour line standing on the work order.
2. Where no check that found rework needed stands on the work order and the coverage stands in force, the credit is measured against the largest line priced under the bench labour charge code.
3. In any other case the line the credit is measured against is not changed on these grounds.

## Questions answered

**What does "the largest bench labour line standing on the work order" take in?** Every line the bench has priced as labour on that order, the largest of them by amount.

**What does "the largest line priced under the bench labour charge code" take in?** Those labour lines the order carries under the bench labour charge code itself, the largest of them by amount; labour lines the order carries under another priced line, such as sizing or stone setting, are not among them.

**What if the check that found rework needed was logged some time ago?** Clause 1 asks only whether such a check stands on the work order, not when it was logged.

**What if two lines are of the same amount?** Both clauses select by amount, and where two lines stand at the same largest amount the amount the credit is measured against is that amount.

## Hypothetical readings of one order

A work order carries four labour lines: 320.00 USD under the bench labour charge code, 410.00 USD for sizing, 180.00 USD under the bench labour charge code, and 260.00 USD for stone setting.

- Where a check that found rework needed stands on the order and the coverage stands in force, the line is the largest bench labour line standing on the order, 410.00 USD.
- Where no such check stands and the coverage stands in force, the line is the largest under the bench labour charge code, 320.00 USD.
- Where the coverage does not stand in force, neither clause bears and the line is not changed on these grounds.
